#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=InLocCIIRC_demo
#   --nodes=1
#   --partition gpu
#   --output=InLocCIIRC_demo.log
#   --cpus-per-task=8
#   --gres=gpu:1
#   --mem=16G
#   --mail-type=END,FAIL
#   --time=1-00:00:00

#flux: --job-name=InLocCIIRC_demo
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 8
#flux: --time-limit=24h
#flux: --output=InLocCIIRC_demo.log

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without a GPU, causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem=16G
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition gpu
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on non-GPU nodes or have different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm option: --mail-type=END,FAIL
# Flux does not provide a universal, built-in email notification directive in batch scripts.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but you will not receive automatic job emails.

module load MATLAB/2018a
module load SuiteSparse/5.1.2-foss-2018b-METIS-5.1.0

nvidia-smi

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/home/lucivpav/gflags-2.2.2/build/lib:/home/lucivpav/InLoc_demo/functions/vlfeat/toolbox/mex/mexa64

cat startup.m inloc_demo.m | matlab -nodesktop

reasons: The original Slurm job required 1 GPU (`--gres=gpu:1`) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this may allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run much slower.

The original Slurm job requested 16G of memory (`--mem=16G`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this may under-provision the job and risk OOM.

The original Slurm job specified a GPU partition (`--partition gpu`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
